subject: general
question: Who flagged off India’s first exported locomotive to Guinea in June 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In **June 2025**, Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** flagged off India’s first exported locomotive specifically destined for **Guinea**, marking a historic achievement in the nation's railway sector.
 
• This locomotive was manufactured under the **Make in India** initiative, demonstrating the country’s growing prowess in **heavy engineering** and the production of high-performance railway rolling stock for the global market.
 
• The export to the **West African** nation of **Guinea** is part of a strategic vision to enhance India’s footprint in the **Global South** and strengthen bilateral trade relations through infrastructure support.
 
• The flagging-off ceremony highlights the successful implementation of the **Atmanirbhar Bharat** (Self-Reliant India) mission, where domestic manufacturing units are now capable of meeting international technical standards and specifications.
 
• The locomotive is designed to support **Guinea's** logistics and mining operations, particularly for the transport of **Bauxite**, which is a primary export of the country. ***Hence, the correct answer is Narendra Modi.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **RITES Limited:**
 
 
• The export of locomotives and other rolling stock is typically facilitated by **RITES Ltd** (Rail India Technical and Economic Service), which is a **Miniratna (Category-I)** Schedule 'A' **Public Sector Enterprise** under the **Ministry of Railways**.
 
• **RITES** acts as the export arm and provides consultancy services for transport, infrastructure, and related technologies in over **55 countries** across **Africa**, **Asia**, and **Latin America**.
 
 
 
• **India-Guinea Relations:**
 
 
• **Guinea** is a vital partner for India in **West Africa**, especially concerning energy security and mineral resources. India is one of the largest trading partners of **Guinea**.
 
• The provision of Indian railway technology helps **Guinea** modernize its transport network, which is essential for its economic development and the **mining sector**.
 
 
 
• **Manufacturing Hubs:**
 
 
• Major production units of **Indian Railways**, such as the **Banaras Locomotive Works (BLW)** in **Varanasi** and the **Chittaranjan Locomotive Works (CLW)**, play a crucial role in manufacturing these export-quality engines.
 
• The shift toward exporting **Diesel** and **Electric** locomotives reflects India's transition from being an importer of railway technology to a net exporter.
 
 
 
• **Global Reach of Indian Railways:**
 
 
• Apart from **Guinea**, India has successfully exported locomotives, coaches, and wagons to countries like **Sri Lanka**, **Bangladesh**, **Myanmar**, **Vietnam**, and **Mozambique**.
 
• The **Ministry of Railways**, currently headed by **Ashwini Vaishnaw** (as of 2024-2025), has been instrumental in modernizing the rail network and promoting the **Vande Bharat** technology for future international markets.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Technical Customization:** Exported locomotives are often customized to match the **track gauge** (such as **Cape Gauge** or **Standard Gauge**) and the specific environmental conditions of the destination country.
 
• **Economic Impact:** Such exports contribute significantly to India's **Gross Domestic Product (GDP)** and help in narrowing the trade deficit by earning valuable **foreign exchange**.
 
• **Geopolitical Significance:** Strengthening infrastructure in **African** nations through the **India-Africa Forum Summit** framework fosters long-term diplomatic and strategic partnerships.
